moves.name: Encore
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description:
Water (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.description:
Normal (Physical)
Base Power: 40
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 3
Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from physical attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.description:
Dark (Physical)
Base Power: 95
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.description:
Fire (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 85
Priority: 0
Burns the target.

moves.name: Disable
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.

moves.name: Quash
moves.description:
Dark (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description:
Fire (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sun. The damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Heat Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sun.

items.name: Roseli Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Fairy-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Light Clay
items.description: Holder's use of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, or Reflect lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.description: Holder is grounded, Speed halved. If Flying type, takes neutral Ground damage.

items.name: Bright Powder
items.description: The accuracy of attacks against the holder is 0.9x.

items.name: Wide Lens
items.description: The accuracy of attacks by the holder is 1.1x.

items.name: Damp Rock
items.description: Holder's use of Rain Dance lasts 8 turns instead of 5.

abilities.name: Prankster
abilities.description: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

abilities.name: Stall
abilities.description: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.
